description: Implementation of JSON Pointer handling in Go, including parsing, getting, setting, and encoding/decoding JSON pointer tokens.

classes.name: Pointer
classes.description: Represents a JSON Pointer with methods for parsing, retrieving, setting, and string conversion.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON pointer string into reference tokens.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a JSON document using the pointer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value in a JSON document at the location specified by the pointer.

methods.name: DecodedTokens
methods.description: Returns the list of decoded tokens.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the pointer is empty (points to root).

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: Offset
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset of the pointer in a JSON document.
